en: Most liquid soaps are mixed with synthetic surfactants, but our formula has fatty-acid salts from plant oils as its main component and contains no synthetic surfactants (detergents), so it is a real liquid soap — referring to the definition of “real liquid soap” in TIS S 14-2562

th: ในสูตรมี Potassium Hydroxide แล้วมีด่างตกค้างหรือไม่?

en: Rest assured: “no leftover alkali that irritates the skin”. The finished soap has been tested for free alkali: Not Detected

th: ความชุ่มชื้นเพิ่มขึ้นจริงหรือไม่?
